channel.title: International Business Times India - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from International Business Times India (ibtimes.co.in)

item.title: Sensex, Nifty post early losses over geopolitical tensions, oil prices
item.description: As of 9.25 am, Sensex lost 516 points, or 0.68 per cent, to reach 75,517 and Nifty eased 174 points, or 0.74 per cent, to reach 23,464.

item.title: Iran's Mojtaba Khamenei orders Strait of Hormuz closed amid war, signals more attacks on US
item.description: Iran's UN envoy reiterated Iran's commitment to freedom of navigation in the Strait of Hormuz but blamed US actions for regional instability, while Khamenei vowed the strait's closure would remain a strategic lever amid ongoing conflict

item.title: West Asia tensions leave Mumbai captain and LPG tanker stranded near Strait of Hormuz
item.description: Merchant navy captain Virendra Vishwakarma from Dahisar has been stranded near the Strait of Hormuz for over a week as tensions escalate in West Asia. His LPG tanker carrying fuel equal to about 36 lakh domestic cylinders was halted due to security restrictions.

item.title: Kritika Kamra in ivory gown, Gaurav Kapur in black formals; fans unhappy with newlyweds' wedding reception look
item.description: Several Bollywood and cricket stars, including Farhan Akhtar, Anya Singh, Sachin Tendulkar, and Yuvraj Singh, attended the glamorous after-party of Kritika Kamra and Gaurav Kapur's wedding. The party had a black-and-blue theme, and the celebrities' outfits were perfectly coordinated.

item.title: US gains when oil prices rise; Trump boasts "we make a lot of money"
item.description: U.S. President Donald Trump stated that rising oil prices benefit the United States, as it is the world's largest crude producer. He emphasized that his top priority is preventing Iran from acquiring nuclear weapons, warning that Tehran's ambitions threaten regional and global security.

item.title: Hardik Pandya kissing Mahieka Sharma with India flag on sparks row; FIR filed for insulting national flag
item.description: An advocate has filed a complaint with Pune Police seeking an FIR against cricketer Hardik Pandya for allegedly insulting the national flag during India's T20 World Cup celebrations in Ahmedabad. Clips show Hardik draping the flag while lying on the podium and kissing his girlfriend, Mahieka Sharma.

item.title: 'Watch what happens today': Trump threatens Iran; Tehran claims strike on USS Abraham Lincoln, US denies
item.description: US President Donald Trump issued a fresh threat to Iran on Truth Social, claiming its military capabilities were being destroyed, as his remarks escalated tensions amid the ongoing conflict and drew global attention to rising geopolitical risks in the Middle East.

item.title: Gold, silver prices ease over profit booking, consolidation trend
item.description: Gold and silver prices eased slightly on Friday amid profit booking and consolidation after recent record highs. MCX gold April futures fell 0.14% to Rs 1,60,046 per 10 grams, while MCX silver May futures declined 0.19% to Rs 2,67,448 per kg

item.title: Strategic commitment or strategic restraint: Navigating the alliance security dilemma in era of entrapment
item.description: The U.S. entry into the 2026 Israel-Iran war shows how unconditional alliances can drag powers into conflicts outside their core interests. History—from 1914 Germany to U.S. policy under Eisenhower and Bush Sr.—demonstrates that calibrated ambiguity and conditionality preserve control, while overreliance on tactics like precision strikes increases risk.

item.title: Malaika Arora goes bold in daring neckline, attends Kritika Kamra, Gaurav Kapur bash with Harsh Mehta [reactions]
item.description: Malaika Arora and her rumoured boyfriend Harsh Mehta were spotted at Kritika Kamra and Gaurav Kapur's wedding party. While Malaika happily posed for the paparazzi, Harsh tried to enter the venue discreetly, but the paps captured a video of him entering.
